events.title: It's official: Pages of Tomorrow is coming to Steam on December 9th!
events.summary: I'm looking forward to showing you all the game I've been working super hard on over the past year (actually, a little more than that). I'm officially announcing the release date: it's December 9, 2026. Have a look at the new trailer!Remember to wishlist the game to be notified when it launches!

events.title: Pages of Tomorrow is taking part in the First Love Visual Novel Fest!
events.summary: I'm proud to announce that Pages of Tomorrow is officially taking part in the First Love Visual Novel Fest! Tune in on October 23rd for a surprise, and keep an eye on the event's official YouTube channel.See you there!

events.title: To give hope in a hopeless world. Why Pages of Tomorrow is being made
events.summary: When creating something, whether it's a book, a game, or something else entirely, I like to have a purpose for it. Something I want to say with it, something more than just "once upon a time..." – it's not the law, but it is my preference. With Pages of Tomorrow, this purpose is very apparent. events.title: The literary and game inspirations behind Pages of Tomorrow – short a list
events.summary: Every work of art (and I think of games as works of art) has its inspirations. Obviously, I do not mean outright imitation, as that can kill creative processes before they even begin. events.title: Pages of Tomorrow and diversity. A word on creating characters
events.summary: Diversity is important. Creating all characters in a story to be the same wastes the potential of having them be different people, when showcasing different perspectives and outlooks on life is one of the things art does best. Pages of Tomorrow's characters are definitely a diverse bunch, and I'd like to explain why I think that. events.title: Relationships in Pages of Tomorrow. Why no romance?
events.summary: Social relationships are inherent to the human experience. Whether one wants it or not, true lone wolves do not exist – from the day we are born, we are all shaped by other people. At first, familial relations are most important (as well as most influential for our development). But as we grow, parents are replaced by peers, who we begin to excitedly call our friends. events.title: Pages of Tomorrow demo available now!
events.summary: The Pages of Tomorrow demo is officially here!It's official – you can now get to know Pages of Tomorrow's characters and setting for free! This little sneak peek into the story lets players get a feel of what the full visual novel will be like. Step into the unusual world of hospitalized teenagers and see for yourself what kind of mystery Alex will be forced to solve.And remember – not everything is as it seems.

events.title: Meet Pages of Tomorrow's main characters!
events.summary: All stories need characters. In Pages of Tomorrow, the player meets an array of them – but some, obviously, are more important than others. The three that I will very briefly introduce here are arguably the most crucial, as the player is constantly choosing between them, deciding on their companion for the playthrough. events.title: Why I call Pages of Tomorrow a "psychological" visual novel. On genre
events.summary: Genre, helpful as it can be for self-identification, is a commitment and a promise. With genre come certain expectations, tropes, and other things the writer must be aware of. Keeping that in mind, calling Pages of Tomorrow a "mystery" visual novel doesn't quite do it for me. I will try, to the best of my ability, to explain why that is – and why I settled on "psychological" instead.Pages of Tomorrow isn't a thriller. events.title: To lie or not to lie. How Pages of Tomorrow approaches portraying a psych ward
events.summary: As some of you may already know, Pages of Tomorrow aims to portray mental illness and psychiatric care as accurately as possible. The ward where the story takes place is the beating heart of the plot – it dictates what the characters can or cannot do, what they are like, and even how they think. events.title: Pages of Tomorrow announced!
events.summary: I am thrilled to announce my new psychological visual novel, Pages of Tomorrow. Are you ready to challenge fate?Take on the role of Alex, a teenager struggling with mental health, as she finds herself in the middle of a supernatural mystery. There are secrets to uncover in this ward, but putting the pieces together will not be easy. Forge your own destiny in this tale of recovery and finding happiness – is it true that fate cannot be changed? Wishlist Pages of Tomorrow on Steam right now.
